Portnahaven is a small harbour town, with a little pocket beach. The full length of the beach was 47 m. Houses all around the beach. The beach was covered in fishing gear (lost or abandoned or in use was unclear) canoe boats, buoys and creel pots sat high on the vegetation. Lots of plastics on the beach and on the strandline. Bag full of small black flies. Lots of seaweed.  REMOVED - item in other category that weighs 1826.2 g, this item looks like a small storage space, but was filled with coarse sediment unable to be removed without the inside plastic crumbling. So have discarded this item from count and weight.
